delete.description:
Delete relation.

remove one relation tuple (tenant or

post.description:
Admin delete relation path.

row-action alias.
`id` is the colon-joined tuple the RFW list emits
(`subject_type:subject_id:relation:object_type:object_id`); parsed
back-first (the last three segments are relation/object_type/object_id,
the first is subject_type, the middle rest is subject_id - tolerant of
colons inside subject ids).
Handle admin delete relation path.

post.description:
Sets `read_at = now` on the message. Idempotent - a second call is a
no-op. Used by customer-facing apps (eBank) when the user opens a
message, so the notification badge unread count decreases. The read
receipt `sentin8:post:notification:read` is emitted as a local
`post.outbox` row in the SAME transaction as the read update
(post DESIGN §4) - exactly once with the domain change; the shell
relay produces it to Bus (§6.7).
Handle mark message read.

mark a message as read.

Send message.

CreatePolicySetBody.description:
`POST /v1/admin/policy-sets` - create a tenant policy set (name in body).
Reuses the local PUT core (validation + tenant origin + event + audit),
then redirects the RFW renderer to the editor page.
The createpolicysetbody type.

mine.description:
When `mine=true`, filter to messages where `recipient_user_id` matches
the caller's Auth user UUID. Used by customer-facing apps (eBank) so
users only see their own messages, not all org/env messages.
The mine.

unread.description:
When `unread=true`, filter to messages where `read_at IS NULL`.
The unread.
